description: Committee to review 2025 Municipal Heritage Advisory work plan.
Saskatoon's 'Doors Open' event on June 1 features 24 buildings.
It seeks $2,000 for printed maps and walking tour signage.
The biennial event expects 6,000 attendees to explore city heritage.

chips.text: Councillors debated the effectiveness of print versus social media advertising for the event.
The event relies on 75-80 community volunteers to staff locations.
Councillor asked if on-site donations could be collected, but it was not resolved.
Staff committed to having the event coordinator present the annual report in person.

description: Saskatoon's 2025 Doors Open event will be June 1.
It features 24 buildings and three walking tours.
Event needs 75-80 volunteers; sponsorship is down.

chips.text: Councillor asked for a detailed list of how the $2000 sponsorship would be spent.
75-80 volunteers are needed from building owners and community members.
The feasibility of collecting donations at event sites was raised but not resolved.
Staff committed to having the event coordinator present their final report in person.

description: No updates were received from subcommittees.
